title: Inconsistent rounding of lock time causes voting power errors
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** High  ## Description  In the VotingEscrow contract, lock end times are consistently rounded down to week boundaries (Thursday 00:00 UTC) in all functions except for `split`. This inconsistency disrupts the checkpoint system and causes incorrect voting power calculations.  In `_create_lock` and `increase_unlock_time`, lock end time is explicitly rounded to weekly boundaries.
